errors.evidence: The description does not reflect the actual content of the figure and incorrectly suggests generic graphic data instead of the specific line chart.
The description does not state what the chart represents, missing the purpose described in atom 'chart_type'.
The description omits the x-axis details (no labels, linear scale) as specified in atoms 'x_axis' and 'x_axis_scale'.
The description does not mention the y-axis range or the absence of units, as specified in atoms 'y_axis_range' and 'y_axis_units'.
The description omits the orange line label and its behavior, as specified in atoms 'orange_line_label' and 'orange_line_value'.
The description omits the grey line label, starting value, ending value, and trend, as specified in atoms 'grey_line_label', 'grey_line_start', 'grey_line_end', and 'grey_line_trend'.
The description omits the yellow line label and its behavior, as specified in atoms 'yellow_line_label' and 'yellow_line_value'.
The description omits the blue line label and its trend, as specified in atoms 'blue_line_label' and 'blue_line_trend'.
The phrase introduces unrelated and nonsensical content not present in the figure or supported by any atom.
The phrase is grammatically incorrect and unclear in context.
The description is overly vague and does not specify any details about the figure's content or structure.
